title: vincetoxicum heterophyllum
intro: Vincetoxicum heterophyllum, commonly known as Chinese swallowwort, is a plant species belonging to the Apocynaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant health benefits. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and stress, and improve sleep quality. Bioactive constituents of Vincetoxicum heterophyllum include iridoid glycosides, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its pharmacological effects.
